#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Avicenna Research] (Support, Avicenna Research) – September 20, 2024 9:12 AM:**  
- Sent a reminder about data deletion for trial study #3748, "Daily Life at UTM (Winter 2024)".  
- Explained that trial studies are regularly cleaned up unless a license is purchased.  
- Provided instructions to contact sales to retain data.  
- *Key quote:* "If you need to keep these data in your Avicenna account, please contact sales@avicennaresearch.com."  

- **[Joanne Chung] (Researcher, University of Toronto) – September 20, 2024 (Time not specified):**  
- Expressed confusion about data deletion despite having purchased an invoice.  
- Requested clarification on the issue.  
- *Key quote:* "I thought that we had purchased an invoice so it is not clear why the data are being deleted."  

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – September 20, 2024 12:13 PM:**  
- Confirmed manual licensing of the study and linked it to the purchased license.  
- Mentioned ongoing platform improvements to automate the process.  
- Offered assistance for future concerns.  
- *Key quote:* "I set the study as licensed and linked it to the license you had purchased."  

- **[Joanne Chung] (Researcher, University of Toronto) – September 20, 2024 (Time not specified):**  
- Thanked Mohammad for resolving the issue.  
- *Key quote:* "Thanks, Mohammad, you're the best."
